wz:next.visible: newGame.priceNorte != null AND newGame.priceSul != null AND newGame.priceLeste != null AND newGame.priceOeste != null

wz:done.visible: !#empty(newGame.opponent) AND newGame.kickoff != null AND newGame.status != null

y:labels.y:label: (type == null ? 'Lançamento' : type.code == 'AUTHORIZATION' ? 'Autorização' : type.code == 'CAPTURE' ? 'Captura' : type.code == 'PARTIAL_CAPTURE' ? 'Captura parcial' : type.code == 'REFUND_FOLLOW_ON' ? 'Estorno' : type.code == 'REFUND_STANDALONE' ? 'Estorno avulso' : type.code == 'CANCEL' ? 'Cancelamento da autorização' : type.code == 'REVIEW_DECISION' ? 'Revisão' : type.code) + ' · R$ ' + (amount == null ? '-' : amount.setScale(2, 4).toPlainString().replace('.', ',')) + ' · ' + (transactionStatus == 'ACCEPTED' ? 'Aceito' : transactionStatus == 'REJECTED' ? 'Recusado' : transactionStatus == 'REVIEW' ? 'Em revisão' : transactionStatus == 'ERROR' ? 'Erro' : (transactionStatus ?: '-'))
